text:
marta: FYI planning to promote release v2.3.1-canary in Thu 22:00 UTC change window. Preflight prompt-eval flagged a regression on the summarizer (microbench-A): ROUGE-L down 6.2% vs baseline. Need decision: pin prod route to v2.2.9 or proceed with canary + staged fallback.

ishaan: Can you paste the failed prompt examples and the eval summary? Is this widespread or a localized skew?

marta: Quick summary: quantized variant (q8) shows most of the drop; float32 variant looks within thresholds. eval-gate shows `fail_rate: 18% (threshold 10%)` and top issue is conversational truncation.

leah: If it's quant-specific we can route quantized traffic to the older model during rollout. Option: start 20% canary with `model_variant: float32`, then 50/50 after 2 hours if stable. Otherwise pin route back to previous stable.

sam: For customer SLAs I'd prefer pinning prod and continuing canary in non-prod. Also we can enable deploybot auto-fallback on eval-gate failures.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled canary rollout for v2.3.1 at 2167897921; auto-fallback on gate_failure is ENABLED. To change schedule reply `cancel` or `update config`.

qa-bot: eval-gate report attached: summarizer suite A — regressions on conversational truncation TTL; top failing prompt ids: #452, #471. Report: http://ci/reports/21678

ishaan: My preference: don't pin globally yet. Proposed plan: 1) hold prod pin to v2.2.9, 2) run focused bisect to isolate quant layer, 3) if fix in 24h re-promote. Who picks up bisect?

marta: assigning to @ishaan and @leah. @deploybot please postpone prod promotion and allow canary in staging only.

deploybot: deploybot: prod promotion postponed. Staging-only canary scheduled. Notifying on-call.

leah: :thumbsup: I'll start bisect now. ETA ~6h. I'll post interim results here.

sam: Sounds good. Also please add release-note blurb: "Temporarily holding prod rollout for summarizer due to regression in quantized variant; staging canary continuing."
